dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: Dear, why did you sneak outside again?

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Oh, uh, don't worry! The night's not quite as hot, so it's perfect for getting some fresh air outside.

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: The night is much cooler than the day, which makes it all the more reason to take better care of your health. Besides, you should stay where there's more greenery...

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Yes, I know, I know. I just need to get out sometimes, you know? Just sometimes.

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Look at you! You're so young, but already sound like my folks.

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: Wh—What? ...I mean, anyone who cares about you would say that! ...Ahem, anyway. How's the pot of flowers I gave you?

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Um, yes, thanks for sending me the flowers. They are very beautiful. But the leaves are starting to turn yellow...

dialogues.speaker: Nermin
dialogues.text: Sorry for not taking good care of them...

dialogues.speaker: Raef
dialogues.text: N—No, don't apologize! It's fine, it's not your fault!
